name: shellcheck-after-edit
description: Format and lint edited shell scripts with approval-gated consumer-owned Codex hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Format and lint edited shell scripts.
interface.longDescription: Use ShellCheck and shfmt on reported .sh and .bash edits through an approval-gated, consumer-owned Codex PostToolUse hook. Installation exposes the skill and references only; it does not activate or install a hook.
capabilities: Exact-file shfmt then ShellCheck after approved edits
Independent ShellCheck and shfmt policy selection
defaultPrompt: Use $shellcheck-after-edit to lint shell scripts or propose an approval-gated ShellCheck and shfmt edit hook.
